propositions: test.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml hand-copy identical gate+suite command sets across jobs, causing drift risk policed by a copy-sync guard that can be eliminated by extracting shared logic into a single reusable workflow_call file

The monolithic build-and-test job in gerrit-verify.yaml must be replaced by a delegating call to a new _build-and-test.yml reusable that defines three jobs (lint, pip-audit, test matrix) with gerrit-refspec-parameterized checkout, taking no secrets

test_ci_workflow_parity.py's five enforcement functions must be rewritten to validate single-source delegation (both callers use the reusable) and preserve three safety invariants: gate-runs-shared, no-drift-script, and precommit-SKIP; plus update test_workflow_names.py to cover the new reusable

The refactored path (test.yml calling the reusable via branch-head) first executes post-merge; gerrit-verify.yaml's own Verified run on this change uses the old inline gate because g2p dispatches from main's ref
